data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘tranasa’ meaning ‘to cross’ or ‘to move over’, this name signifies a river or a body of water. The name Tr carries the meaning “River” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Hindi. Parents who choose Tr usually hope their child will grow to embody river and live with faith, good character and purpose.
